title: Part (b): coherence barrier (Step 3 of Thm thm:fail) is heuristic, not proved

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Severity: gap (headline claim).** The headline barrier
$$s\ \gtrsim\ \mu\,\mathrm{sr}(A)\,\max(m,n)/\varepsilon$$
is derived in Step 3 of Thm. `thm:fail` only up to "$\asymp$" and under the qualifier "for a flat spectrum ($\mathrm{sr}(A)=\Theta(r)$)". Substituting Lemma `lem:colenergy` ($\max_j\|A_{:,j}\|^2\le\sigma_1^2\mu r/n$) into eq. `eq:barrier` produces a ratio $\mu r/\mathrm{sr}(A)$ which is silently collapsed to $\Theta(\mu)$. For general spectral decay this is invalid, so the stated coherence-inflated barrier is not a theorem for arbitrary $A$.

**Suggested fix.** Carry $\mu r/\mathrm{sr}(A)$ explicitly and state the rigorous barrier as
$$s\ \gtrsim\ \frac{mn}{\theta^2}\,\sigma_1^2\,\frac{\mu r}{n},$$
claiming the $\Theta(\mu)$ inflation only under the explicit flat-spectrum hypothesis $\mathrm{sr}(A)=\Theta(r)$.
